questions.question: In which year was Sati banned in India?
questions.solution:
• Sati Abolition: 1829
  • Effort: Legalized by Bentinck due to Raja Ram Mohan Roy's work.

questions.question: Which of the following is the oldest Veda?
questions.solution:
• Rigveda: Rigveda
  • Fact: The oldest known Vedic text.

questions.question: Who became the first Governor-General of India in 1773?
questions.solution:
• First Governor-General: Warren Hastings
  • Year: Appointed in 1773 under the Regulating Act.

questions.question: The Lion Capital was built in commemoration of the historical event of the Buddha’s:
questions.solution:
• Lion Capital Purpose: first sermon
  • Location: Built by Ashoka at Sarnath.

questions.question: The Battle of Khanwa was fought between:
questions.option_2: Sher Shah Suri and Rana Sangha
questions.solution:
• Battle of Khanwa: Babur and Rana Sangha
  • 1527: Secured Mughal supremacy in the north.

questions.question: Who of the following founded the Atmiya Samaj?
questions.solution:
• Atmiya Samaj (1815): Raja Ram Mohan Roy
  • Goal: To propagate monotheism and social reform.

questions.question: ____________ was founded by the Dadoba Pandurang and his brother Atmaram Pandurang in 1863 when Keshub Chandra Sen visited Maharashtra, with an aim to make people believe in one God and worship only one God.
questions.solution:
• Prarthana Samaj: Prarthana Samaj
  • 1863/67: Founded by the Pandurang brothers in Bombay.

questions.question: Which of the following cities existed in the Indus Valley Civilization?
questions.solution:
• Harappa: Harappa
  • Archaeology: First site discovered, located on the Ravi river.

questions.question: In which year did Tipu Sultan die defending his capital Seringapatam?
questions.solution:
• Death of Tipu (1799): 1799
  • Event: Occurred during the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War.

questions.question: Who among the following Chola rulers built Nishumbhasudini Goddess temple in Thanjavur?
questions.solution:
• Nishumbhasudini Temple: Vijayalaya
  • History: Vijayalaya built this in Thanjavur after capturing it.

questions.question: Khajuraho temple in Madhya Pradesh is an example of ___________ style of temple architecture.
questions.solution:
• Khajuraho Style: Nagara
  • Architecture: Famous for its Panchayatana layout in Madhya Pradesh.

questions.question: Mangal Pandey was hanged to death for attacking British officers in Barrackpore on ______.
questions.solution:
• Mangal Pandey: 29 March 1857
  • Incident: Attacked officers at Barrackpore.

questions.question: Pulakesin I was the founder of ______ dynasty of South India.
questions.solution:
• Chalukya Founder: Pulakesin I
  • Note: Established the dynasty in South India.

questions.question: Which of the following universities was founded by Kumaragupta, the ruler of the Gupta dynasty?
questions.solution:
• Nalanda Founder: Nalanda University
  • Gupta King: Kumaragupta I founded it in the 5th century.

questions.question: What was the original name of Swami Vivekananda?
questions.solution:
• Vivekananda's Name: Narendranath Dutta
  • Title: Suggested by the Maharaja of Khetri.

questions.question:
Which of the given statements related to the temples of India is correct?
I.The Nagara style of architecture is also known as the North Indian style
II.The Dravidian style of architecture is also known as the South Indian style.
questions.solution:
• Nagara & Dravidian: Both I and II
  • Styles: North Indian (Nagara) and South Indian (Dravidian).

questions.question: Dantidurga belonged to which dynasty of India?
questions.solution:
• Dantidurga Dynasty: Rashtrakuta
  • Ceremony: Performed 'Hiranya-garbha' to become a Kshatriya.

questions.question: All India Muslim League was formed in ______.
questions.solution:
• Muslim League (1906): 1906
  • Detail: Formed in Dacca to safeguard Muslim rights.

questions.question: Who among the following founded Brahmo Samaj in Calcutta (Kolkata)?
questions.solution:
• Brahmo Samaj Founder: Raja Ram Mohan Roy
  • Note: Founded in Calcutta to reform Hinduism.

questions.question: Harshavardhana (r. 606-647 CE) was a ruler of __________ dynasty.
questions.solution:
• Pushyabhuti: Pushyabhuti
  • King: Harshavardhana belonged to this dynasty.

questions.question: Who wrote the hymn ‘Vande Mataram’?
questions.solution:
• Vande Mataram: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee
  • Source: From the novel 'Anandamath'.

questions.question: ___________ has often been called the incubator of Western civilisation.
questions.solution:
• Incubator of Civilisation: Mediterranean Sea
  • Geography: Connected Greece, Rome, and Egypt.

questions.question: Which Act passed by British Government of India abolished the Council of India?
questions.solution:
• Council Abolition: GOI Act 1935
  • Impact: Abolished the Council of India of the Secretary of State.

questions.question: _________ was the capital of Chalukya dynasty.
questions.solution:
• Inamgaon: Ghod
  • Archaeology: Post-Harappan settlement on the Ghod river.

questions.question: Inamgaon, an important Archaeological site is situated on ______ river.
questions.solution:
• Narayana Guru: Shree Narayana Guru
  • Quote: 'One caste, one religion, one God'.
